whoItsFor: Developers and engineers who want to run open LLMs locally or on their own servers, and connect them to apps, coding agents, or the Ollama REST and Python/JavaScript APIs.
useCases: Chat with a local open model from the terminal using `ollama run <model>`
Serve a model over the REST API at localhost:11434 for an app or script
Connect coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode to a local model via `ollama launch`
